run_metadata.coverage_summary: Discovery was performed via web search only. In this environment the direct page-fetch tools (WebFetch and curl) are blocked by the session network policy (DNS failures / HTTP 403 from the egress proxy for all non-allowlisted hosts), so no tender detail page, portal listing, or specification document could be opened directly. All findings below come from search-engine result summaries. The live JS-rendered government portals (AusTender, NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, etc.) could not be read directly and the general search index lagged well behind the last-7-days window, so most surfaced opportunities are mid-2026 (already closed) and were discarded. A small set of genuinely current, buyer-originated opportunities closing in Nov-Dec 2026 were confirmed from search summaries and are reported at headline level only (no deliverables/document extraction was possible). Tier 3 (private sector) was queried (SAP Ariba Discovery, EstimateOne, ICN Gateway, Woolworths/Coles Ariba, Qantas Coupa, BHP, BAE Systems) but no publicly-visible corporate RFx was found — those channels are registration- or invitation-gated, so only the portals are recorded in discovered_sources, not invented opportunities.
gaps: WebFetch tool non-functional in this environment: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every host, including example.com. No tender detail page or document could be fetched.

Direct curl through the egress proxy returned HTTP 403 (CONNECT tunnel failed) for www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au: these hosts are not in this session's network allowlist, which covers only package registries, GitHub and Anthropic endpoints. Per proxy policy these 403s were not retried.

As a result, deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, contacts and exact values could not be extracted for any opportunity. All five tenders are headline-level and need a future authenticated/unblocked detail pass.
Tier 1 AusTender (Commonwealth): no specific current ATM confirmed via search; the index returned only guidance pages and stale/aggregator listings. Not exhaustively covered this run.

Tier 1 NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, ACT Tenders: search returned only stale (mid-2026, already-closed) or aggregator data; no current open tender confirmed from the buyer's own portal this run.

Tier 3 private sector: SAP Ariba Discovery, Coupa, EstimateOne, ICN Gateway, Woolworths/Coles (Ariba), Qantas (Coupa), BHP, BAE Systems (Ivalua) were queried but all individual opportunities are login/registration-gated or invitation-only; no publicly-visible corporate RFx was discoverable. Recorded portals only, per spec. Management-consultancy RFPs remain invitation-only and out of scope.

SA Water Eyre Peninsula Desalination design-support opportunity (via Acciona ECI, reportedly closing 31 Dec 2026) and a Townsville City Council tender (close 4 Nov 2026) were seen only via aggregators with no buyer-confirmed title/detail and were NOT included as tenders to avoid fabrication; SA Water Supplier Portal is an existing known source.

Aggregator-only signals (bidwizard.com.au 'tender trends Oct 2026' blog, GovWatch AU / samsearch defence tracker, australiantenders.com.au, bidsfactory) were used only as discovery signals, not as sources of truth.
recommended_seed_additions: BAE Systems Australia source-to-pay (Ivalua) supplier platform — https://www.baesystems.com/en-aus/suppliers/source-to-pay (defence prime migrating to Ivalua S2C; buyer-originated, registration-gated).

GovWatch AU real-time Defence/national-security procurement tracker (https://samsearch.co) — transparency/aggregator tracker, low confidence as a buyer-originated source; use only as a discovery signal.

discovered_sources.source_name: BAE Systems Australia — Source-to-Pay (Ivalua) supplier platform

discovered_sources.source_name: GovWatch AU — real-time Defence/national-security procurement tracker
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Web search on new Australian procurement platforms launched in 2026; surfaced as a newly-launched tracker aggregating federal/state Defence, national-security and emergency-services tenders, contracts and grants.
discovered_sources.notes: NOT buyer-originated — it is a transparency/aggregator tracker. Use only as a discovery signal to spot buyers/opportunities, then pivot to the buyer's own source (e.g. AusTender). Low confidence by design.
